list_posts.description: List or search a site's published posts, newest first unless sorted otherwise. Narrow by words, category, tag, author, a date range or a slug. Each post comes back with its author's name, its featured image URL and its category and tag names already filled in, plus the excerpt; turn on Include content for the full body as HTML and as plain text. The result carries the site's total, so a workflow knows how many pages there are without fetching them.

description: Read any public WordPress site without a login: its posts, pages, categories, tags, comments, media library, authors and custom post types, straight from the REST API every WordPress site publishes. Watch a blog for new posts, pull a post's text for summarising, search a site, or read a shop's products. No account or API key required.
